name: AKG CK32 (omni capsule, no cal file)
notes: Omnidirectional condenser capsule; needs phantom power through an XLR interface. Its response is close to flat, but without an individual cal file the tool stays conservative: 100 Hz to 12 kHz, boosts up to +3 dB. If you have a cal file for your capsule, load it and choose the calibrated tier.
